A LITTLE PREPARATION GOES A LONG WAY

Before you hit the road.

01 / CHOOSE YOUR DATES

A day or a little longer?

Send your preferred pickup date, return date, and rider count. Availability and rental duration will be confirmed directly.

02 / CONFIRM THE DETAILS

Know your ride.

Ask about the model, rate, deposit, helmet, fuel policy, mileage, insurance, and pickup or return arrangements.

03 / RIDE PREPARED

Ready for the road.

Bring the documents required to ride legally in Sri Lanka. Confirm licence and permit requirements before agreeing your rental.

GOOD TO KNOW

A few things you might ask.

Which bikes are available?

Contact us with your dates and preferred type of bike. We’ll share the current options and photos. Models and availability can change.

How much does a rental cost?

Ask for a quote for your chosen bike and dates. Confirm the full rate, deposit, and any additional charges with our team before booking.

Can I collect a bike in Tangalle?

We are based in Tangalle. Contact us to agree the exact collection and return location before you travel.

Is my enquiry a confirmed booking?

No. Your bike rental is confirmed only after the availability, price, documents, and terms have been agreed directly with our team.
